Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  
Mastercard Payment Networks Technology team is looking for a Sr. Software Engineer to drive our customer experience strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem-solving. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset.  
  
Role  

* Independently translate business and system requirements into pragmatic designs, modular code, rapid AI proofs of concept (PoCs), minimum viable products (MVPs), and production-ready applications.
* Build AI-powered applications and backend services using hosted foundation-model APIs, SDKs, enterprise data, and reusable services; evaluate ideas quickly and recommend whether they should progress, pivot, or stop.
* Build end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions covering ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector or hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, citations, and permission-aware responses.
* Build and integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers that expose enterprise tools, prompts, resources, data, and services through standardized, governed, and auditable interfaces.
* Develop agentic workflows using tool calling, orchestration, state and memory patterns, structured outputs, guardrails, confidence controls, output validation, and human-in-the-loop approvals.
* Use Claude, GitHub Copilot, and comparable AI-assisted engineering tools hands-on to accelerate discovery, prototyping, coding, testing, documentation, and code review while protecting confidential information and validating generated output.
* Define engineering standards, evaluation criteria, and automated validation processes for AI-powered applications and developer productivity solutions, ensuring high quality, reliability, security, maintainability, and operational excellence.
* Productionize validated AI solutions using secure coding, automated testing, CI/CD, configuration management, observability, resilience, performance optimization, and rollback strategies.
* Embed security, privacy, compliance, Responsible AI, least-privilege access, role-based authorization, secrets management, data minimization, content safety, and auditability into solution design.
* Collaborate with product owners, architects, platform engineers, quality engineers, domain experts, and business stakeholders to resolve roadblocks and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced Agile environment.

  
All About You  
Must-have qualifications  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong software engineering experience delivering secure, reliable enterprise applications, APIs, backend services, or distributed systems, with the independence expected of a Senior Software Engineer.
* Hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications using modern programming languages, enterprise data, APIs, and AI-assisted development tools.
* Practical experience with LLM applications, RAG, agentic workflows, or similar applied AI patterns.
* Hands-on experience using AI application frameworks, hosted model services, and relevant SDKs to build and integrate enterprise AI solutions.
* Strong understanding of API design, distributed systems, automated testing, secure development, CI/CD, and production support practices.

Preferred qualifications  

* Experience in payments, high-volume transaction processing, or other highly available and regulated technology environments.
* Familiarity with cloud-native platforms, observability, resiliency, and Responsible AI practices.

  
Skills, Tools & Technologies  
Must have:  

* Core: Python or another modern programming language, experience with SQL and other relational or NoSQL databases, backend services and distributed systems for integrating enterprise data, AI capabilities, and resilient high-volume transaction workflows, strong debugging skills, Git, and automated testing.
* AI workflows and quality: LLM application development and RAG, with emphasis on prompts and agent workflows, and guardrails and evaluation logic.
* AI platforms and frameworks: Knowledge of Anthropic APIs, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent hosted-model services, and LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent SDKs.

Good To Have:  

* Enterprise application engineering: REST/gRPC APIs, secure coding, and CI/CD practices that automate testing and evaluation and enable reliable AI application releases.
* Cloud-native reliability and operations: AWS or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, observability, security controls, and high-availability application design.
* Domain technology stack: C/C++, SQL, Unix/Linux, sockets, inter-process communication (IPC), shared memory, and microservices.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Who You Are**

**An agent orchestrator, not a typist.** You don't want to be a faster keyboard. You want to be a manager of agents — handing off the heavy lifting, reviewing the output, and keeping your hands on the architecture. The IDE is a cockpit for orchestration, not a text editor.

**Productively** **lazy.** Your dream workflow: describe the requirement, let the agent build it, verify, ship, next. You automate anything a human shouldn't be doing twice. Your biggest bottleneck should be deciding *what* to build — while AI executes the *how*.

**Fundamentals first.** Data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, networking — you understand the machine, not just the library that wraps it. When a framework breaks, you fix it. When AI gives you the wrong answer, you catch it. Orchestrating agents only works if you can tell good output from garbage.

**First-principles thinker with vision.** You break problems to their core, question the assumptions, and rebuild. A software engineer's job is to architect solutions, not wrestle with syntax. You don't copy an architecture because "that's how it's done" — you ask why and decide if there's a better way.

**High agency.** You don't wait for perfect specs or permission. You find a path, propose it, and move. Large organizations have walls; you figure out which ones to go through, around, or remove — and you do it constructively.

**Bias for action.** Requirements will be messy and priorities will shift. You ship v1, learn, and iterate instead of living in design review.

**Why This Role**

Ford is a 120-year-old company moving fast on AI, and that's the real challenge: building world-class AI applications inside a large enterprise with real constraints — security, compliance, legacy systems. The engineers who thrive here treat those constraints as problems to solve, not reasons to stop. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you're a 10x thinker who wants to build something that matters — and have the grit to push through the hard parts — let's talk.

**What You'll Do**

* **Orchestrate agents to build.** Use AI as your default way of working — agents do the heavy lifting, you direct, review, and harden. You set the bar for how the team builds with AI.

* **Build the AI use cases.** Design and ship AI-powered applications and agents — RAG pipelines, LLM integrations, agentic workflows. Understand what's happening under the hood and make it work in production, at scale.

* **Ship cloud-native systems on GCP.** Design, deploy, operate. You own the architecture, the infrastructure-as-code, and the CI/CD pipeline. No throwing code over the wall.

* **Connect** **systems that don't want to be connected.** Build the integration layer across enterprise SaaS platforms. Expect messy APIs, legacy constraints, and creative problem-solving.

* **Automate what shouldn't be manual.** If a human repeats it, you write the code — or point an agent at it — to stop it.

* **Make other engineers faster.** Build the tools, agent workflows, and guardrails that remove friction. Developer productivity is a multiplier.

**Requirements**

* BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. MS is a plus, not a substitute for shipping software.

* 2+ years building and deploying full-stack applications in production.

* 2+ years on cloud-native platforms (GCP preferred).

* Demonstrable experience building AI agents or applications — show us what you've built, not what you've read.
* **What You Bring**
* + **Python** — deep. You write production systems, not just scripts.
* + **JavaScript / TypeScript** — React, Node.js, or equivalent. A real frontend and a real API. Front-end strength is a big plus.
* + **AI engineering** — LLMs, embeddings, vector stores, RAG. Comfortable building agents and evaluation pipelines. Bonus for fine-tuning or eval work.
* + **AI-assisted development** — fluent with modern AI coding tools and agent workflows, and clear-eyed about where they help and where they don't.
* + **GCP** — Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Storage. Deployed and operated, not just tutorials.
* + **Databases** — relational and NoSQL. You know when to use what, and why.
* + **APIs & microservices** — designed and built RESTful services at scale.
* + **Git,** **IaC** **& CI/CD** — Terraform, Cloud Build, or equivalent. Reproducible, version-controlled infrastructure and disciplined code review.

Role

Principal Software Engineer- Eng

Why UKG:

At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.

We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to join the engineering team for the WFM platform product. This role is focused on leading the technical direction, architecture, and engineering strategy for a modern, scalable, resilient, and intelligent enterprise SaaS product platform.
  
As a Principal Software Engineer, you will play a key role in defining the technology stack, shaping the technical roadmap, driving architectural decisions, and leading complex engineering initiatives across multiple teams. You will be expected to bring deep technical expertise, enterprise-scale thinking, and a strong understanding of performance, reliability, observability, and operational excellence.
  
  
This role requires a hands-on technical leader who can guide engineering teams through agentic SDLC, complex design decisions, lead technical discussions, troubleshoot critical technical issues, and build scalable and secure platform. The ideal candidate will have strong proficiency in Java, database technologies, cloud-native engineering, distributed systems, and modern AI-assisted software engineering practices.
  
  
We are looking for an engineer who combines strategic technical vision with practical execution, mentors senior engineers, raises engineering standards, and helps build a product platform that is scalable, secure, observable, performant, and ready for the future.
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  

* Define and drive the architectural vision for the WFM platform, ensuring scalability, resiliency, performance, maintainability, and long-term extensibility.
* Lead the evaluation, selection, and evolution of the core technology stack, including application frameworks, cloud-native services, database technologies, observability tools, messaging systems, and AI-enabled engineering capabilities.
* Define and influence the technical roadmap in partnership with engineering leadership, product management, architecture, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Lead architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical decision-making for complex product and platform initiatives.
* Provide technical direction across multiple teams and ensure alignment with enterprise engineering standards, security expectations, and operational goals.
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices to continuously improve product capabilities, developer productivity, and system reliability.

  
Software Engineering & Platform Development
  

* Design and build highly scalable, secure, and reliable cloud-native enterprise platform.
* Lead the development of distributed systems, APIs, backend services, event-driven workflows, and data-intensive applications.
* Drive modernization initiatives that improve system performance, scalability, maintainability, and engineering velocity.
* Establish and promote engineering best practices around code quality, testing, automation, design patterns, performance optimization, and maintainable architecture.
* Lead complex cross-functional engineering initiatives that require coordination across multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders.
* Ensure the product is built with an enterprise-level mindset, including strong consideration for scalability, compliance, security, availability, customer experience, and operational readiness.

  
Observability, Reliability & Operational Excellence
  

* Drive platform-wide improvements in observability, monitoring, logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, and service health management.
* Define and implement observability standards using platforms and tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus, Datadog, Splunk, or similar technologies.
* Lead troubleshooting and root-cause analysis for complex production issues, performance bottlenecks, system failures, and reliability concerns.
* Partner with engineering, operations, and SRE teams to define service-level objectives, operational metrics, error budgets, incident response practices, and reliability

improvement plans.
  

* Lead post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions result in long-term improvements to architecture, automation, resiliency, and monitoring.
* Champion proactive engineering practices that improve product stability, reduce operational risk, and enhance customer trust.

  
Performance Engineering & Scalability
  

* Drive performance tuning across application services, database layers, APIs, integration points, and distributed system components.
* Identify and resolve scalability challenges in high-volume, enterprise-grade SaaS environments.
* Lead capacity planning, load testing, profiling, query optimization, caching strategies, and performance benchmarking efforts.
* Ensure that technical designs account for throughput, latency, concurrency, data growth, resiliency, and cost efficiency.
* Partner with teams to establish measurable performance goals and continuously improve system responsiveness and efficiency.

  
AI-First Engineering & Agents
  

* Bring strong insight into AI trends, AI-assisted engineering, intelligent automation, and agent-based capabilities.
* Drive adoption of AI tools and practices to improve software design, development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and operational workflows.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI and agents within the engineering lifecycle and product ecosystem to improve productivity, quality, and customer value.
* Guide teams on responsible AI usage, including security, privacy, governance, explainability, and reliability considerations.
* Evaluate AI-enabled platforms, developer tools, observability assistants, coding agents, and automation frameworks that can improve engineering outcomes at scale.

  
Database & Data Architecture
  

* Provide technical leadership in database design, data modeling, query optimization, transaction management, and scalable data access patterns.
* Work with relational and non-relational database technologies to support enterprise-grade application requirements.
* Guide teams in designing reliable, performant, and maintainable database solutions that support high-volume data processing and business-critical workflows.
* Lead troubleshooting of complex database performance issues, including indexing, locking, query plans, connection management, data partitioning, and schema evolution.
* Ensure data architecture decisions align with security, compliance, scalability, performance, and long-term maintainability goals.

  
Security, Compliance & Enterprise Readiness
  

* Champion secure software design and development practices across the product.
* Ensure systems are designed with strong consideration for authentication, authorization, data protection, encryption, auditability, and secure integration patterns.
* Promote enterprise readiness through resilient architecture, operational maturity, compliance awareness, and high-quality engineering standards.
* Partner with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure technical solutions align with organizational governance and risk management expectations.

  
Technical Mentorship & Influence
  

* Mentor senior engineers, technical leads, and development teams on architecture, design, engineering practices, troubleshooting, and technical decision-making.
* Lead technical discussions with clarity, influence, and strong engineering judgment.
* Build consensus across teams on complex architecture and design decisions.
* Raise engineering standards through design reviews, technical coaching, documentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

  
Minimum Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 16+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience building enterprise-scale software products.
* Strong proficiency in Java, including modern Java frameworks, backend service development, concurrency, performance tuning, and scalable application design.
* Deep experience with database technologies, including relational databases, SQL optimization, schema design, transaction management, indexing strategies, and performance troubleshooting.
* Proven experience designing and building large-scale distributed systems, microservices, APIs, and cloud-native enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of observability platforms, monitoring, logging, tracing, metrics, alerting, and production diagnostics.
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Experience with performance engineering, including profiling, load testing, capacity planning, caching, query optimization, and system tuning.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS architecture, operational readiness, resiliency, availability, security, and scalability.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture discussions, define technical roadmaps, and influence engineering direction across multiple teams.
* Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, database, and integration layers.
* Strong understanding of AI-assisted software engineering practices, AI tools, and emerging agent-based development or automation models.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, mentoring, and technical leadership skills.

  
Preferred Qualifications
  

* Experience working on large-scale enterprise SaaS products serving global customers.
* Experience defining or evolving a product-level technology stack and long-term technical roadmap.
* Expertise with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, messaging platforms, distributed caching, and asynchronous processing patterns.
* Hands-on experience with observability tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, Splunk, Datadog, or similar platforms.
* Experience leading platform modernization, cloud transformation, or large-scale architecture evolution initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of secure software development, compliance-aware design, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with AI coding assistants, engineering agents, intelligent automation, or AI-enabled operational tooling.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor senior technical talent and establish engineering standards across teams.
* Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical problem solving and delivery execution.

  
Key Attributes
  

* Strategic technical thinker with strong execution discipline.
* Hands-on engineering leader who can guide architecture while also diving deep into technical issues.
* Strong enterprise mindset with focus on reliability, performance, observability, scalability, and security.
* Clear communicator who can lead technical discussions and influence decisions across teams.
* Passionate about engineering excellence, innovation, AI-first development, and continuous improvement.
* Comfortable working in complex environments with multiple stakeholders, systems, and priorities.
